name: Apartmenthaus Nr. 1
beschreibung: Apartmenthaus Nr. 1 is situated in the center of Lienz, just a few minutes' walk from the pedestrian zone. The apartments feature functional amenities with a separate living area and a small kitchen, ideal for self-catering guests. The East Tyrolean Dolomites are easily accessible from the property, whether for summer hiking trips or ski days at the Zettersfeld ski resort in winter. Parking facilities are located nearby.
